# Pronouns sub-actions

## Add pronouns for user

Looks up a Twitch user's pronouns (from alejo.io) and saves them as variables, so you can say "he/him" correctly in chat.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User login** | The Twitch login name to look up. The default is the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userName%`. |
| **Argument prefix** | A word put in front of the variable names. With "target" you get %targetPronoun%. Empty gives %pronoun%. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%hasPronouns%` | True if the person has set pronouns |
| `%pronoun%` | Their pronouns, like He/Him |
| `%pronounSubject%` | The first word, like He |
| `%pronounObject%` | The second word, like Him |
| `%pronounAltSubject%` | The first word of a second set, if they have one |
| `%pronounAltObject%` | The second word of a second set, if they have one |

<small>Type id: `pronouns.addForUser`</small>
